meta.model: homogeneous conformal X (two real fields) + phi; V = lamX/4 r^4 + g2/2 chi^2 r^2 + V_phi
meta.V_phi_M1: lamP/4 (chi^2 - M^2)^2 - epst M (chi - M)^3  (Codex GRUT-M1, d4747cb; epst = 0.002, lamP = 0.03)
meta.V_phi_mode1: lamP/4 chi^4 - lamP/2 M^2 chi^2 - beta lamP M^3 chi  (pt_matching skeptic model; beta = 3 epst/lamP = 0.2 is the linear piece of M1)
meta.growth: M = M0 exp(kappa s), kappa = eps omega_r(initial orbit), M0 = M_start_fac * M_c,peri (0.5 unless stated), M_c = g r/sqrt(lamP)
meta.measure: n_-/q = <[(pX^2/2 + g^2 M^2 r^2/2)/(g M) - q]/(2q)>, N_phi/q = <(dchi_dot^2/2 + m_phi^2 dchi^2/2)/m_phi>/q, dchi = chi - M, m_phi^2 = 2 lamP M^2, window 60 X periods at M_end = 40 M_c,apo
meta.integrator: own adaptive DOP853 in C (m1_dop.c, copied from the skeptic sk_dop.c), rtol 1e-11 unless stated; work integral as extra ODE component
meta.label: [C] computed in a homogeneous classical model; not a cosmological result
